description: At Britam, we understand how much you cherish your car and the need to protect it at all times. That's why we offer comprehensive motor insurance to keep your prized possession safe and sound. Our policy covers accidental damage or overturning, loss or damage by fire and theft, malicious damage, and third party liabilities.
premium_notes: Quote-based — no public price table. Request a callback or download the product brochure.
key_benefits: Free cover for windscreen, theft of audio and video accessories
Free cover for spare wheel, jack and toolbox
Free cover for protection, recovery & towing after accident
Non claim discount – building up to 60% depending on the number of years for not claiming
Discount on fleet
Full discount on Controller Technique fees at renewal
Flexible premium rates and terms
Cover for damage to vehicles in the custody of Motor Trader or Garage
Geographical scope – Kenya but can be extended to other East African countries on request.
Theft - If your car is stolen, our policy will compensate you, subject to an excess (a portion of the sum you have been insured for that you are required to pay).
Fire - If your car catches fire accidentally, our policy covers you.
Accidental Damage - If your car is accidentally damaged, our policy will ensure you get compensation.
Total loss of the car - If the cost of repairs exceeds 50% of the sum assured, our policy considers the car a total loss and covers it accordingly.
Third party liabilities - Our policy covers injury or death of third parties and accidental damage to their property.
how_to_apply: Request a callback online via the product page. Britam also available on WhatsApp: +254705100100.

description: Your Flexible Motor Insurance Solution At Britam General Insurance, we understand that protecting your vehicle is essential, but the upfront cost of comprehensive motor insurance can be challenging. That's why we're excited to introduce Britam MotiFlex- our innovative payment plan designed to make your insurance more accessible and manageable. Comprehensive Coverage, Tailored PaymentsBritam MotiFlex offers the same robust protection as our standard motor insurance policy, covering accidental damage, fire and theft, malicious damage, and third-party liabilities. But with MotiFlex, you gain the flexibility to spread out your premium payments over 12 months, easing the financial burden and aligning with your monthly vehicle-related expenses. Flexible Payment OptionsChoose the payment plan that works best for you- whether it's monthly, quarterly, or semi-annual instalments. Start with an initial payment as low as Kshs. 10,000, and enjoy the convenience of manageable monthly premiums. These payments are adjusted based on standard rates, with a slight adjustment to account for the time value of money, all while providing you the flexibility you need.
premium_notes: Quote-based — no public price table. Request a callback or download the product brochure.
key_benefits: 24/7 Road Rescue Service: Get peace of mind knowing that help is just a call away, anytime, anywhere.
Hassle-Free Claims via WhatsApp: Need to report windscreen damage? Do it quickly and easily through WhatsApp on 0705100100, and we'll handle the rest.
Express Assessment for Minor Claims: Speed up your claims process with our express assessment service, ensuring you're back on the road with minimal disruption.
Financial Flexibility: Spread your insurance costs over time with monthly installments, reducing the strain on your budget.
Align your insurance payments with your income: make it easier to manage your finances without a hefty upfront payment.
Greater Affordability: Smaller, more frequent payments make comprehensive coverage more accessible to everyone.
Enhanced Customer Satisfaction: Experience the convenience of flexible payment options tailored to your lifestyle.
Continuous Coverage: Avoid the risk of having no insurance for your car by maintaining your coverage with manageable monthly payments.
